newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

The government is preparing a concept paper on the sub-regional cooperation among Bangladesh, India, Nepal and Bhutan, spelling out the framework and objectives of the proposed idea, diplomatic sources said.
Relations between Bangladesh and the United States are very good, reinforced by economic cooperation which is playing an important part in fostering it, a State Department official said.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has urged the U.S. Congress to write-off nearly $800 million worth of food assistance given to Bangladesh under PL-480 programme.
Arsenic related diseases have taken a serious turn in 16 districts of southwestern and northern regions of the country, affecting more than 1.5 crore (15 million) people.
The United States supports the idea of regional cooperation among the countries of South Asia for sharing the common resources, a U.S. State Department official said in Dhaka.
A minor son of a college teacher was killed and his wife critically wounded in a sudden attack reportedly by their maid servant in the living quarters at Dhaka's Residential Model College.
Bangladesh Jute Spinners Association expressed deep concern over frequent disruptions in power supply and said it was seriously affecting industrial productions.
